stories.title: The Golden Rickshaw
stories.logline: A struggling rickshaw driver finds a heavy bag of gold coins and must choose between sudden wealth and his own honesty.

episodes.title: The Golden Rickshaw: A Driver's Choice | Pt 1/3
episodes.description: Jian pedals through a neon-lit rainy city and discovers a mysterious leather pouch filled with gold coins on his rickshaw seat.
episodes.caption: A heavy secret waits in the rain. Part 1/3 — save this so you don't miss the next part. What would you do with a bag of gold found in your cab? #Gold #Mystery #StoryTime #RainyNight

episodes.title: Gold Coins in the Cab | Pt 2/3
episodes.description: Jian tries to work through the rain while hiding the heavy bag of gold coins, but a sharp passenger boards and starts asking dangerous questions.
episodes.caption: Is this real gold? Part 2/3 — save this so you don't miss the next part. What would you do with a bag of gold? #story #gold #choices #drama

episodes.title: The Golden Rickshaw: The Final Choice | Pt 3/3
episodes.description: Jian battles his temptation, hands the golden pouch back to its rightful owner, and receives an honest fare that warms his heart.
episodes.caption: I found your gold right here! Part 3/3 — save this so you don't miss the next part. Would you have given the gold back? #Honesty #GoldenRickshaw #StoryTime #GoodDeeds
